instruction: Raspberry Pi HAT+ Connector Pinout Correction The file design.kicad_sch contains a KiCad 10.0.2 schematic with a 2x20 GPIO header (J1, Connector_PinHeader_2.54mm:PinHeader_2x20_P2.54mm_Vertical). For this workflow, start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. All 40 pin net labels are currently named NET_01 through NET_40. Rename every net label so the header's pin-to-net mapping matches the official Raspberry Pi HAT+ 40-pin GPIO specification. Write the corrected schematic as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch. Requirements: 1. All 40 pin labels must be renamed to the correct HAT+ net names. 2. No NET_XX placeholder labels may remain. 3. Power rails shared by multiple pins must use the same net name across all relevant pins. 4. EEPROM interface pins 27 and 28 must be labeled ID_SD and ID_SC respectively. 5. All GPIO labels required by the HAT+ spec must be present. 6. No other changes to the schematic (symbol positions, UUIDs, footprint fields, etc.). Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch.
